notes: «مولى ابن عباس» is Kurayb's patron, not a link; Ibn Abbas, Abd al-Rahman ibn Azhar and al-Miswar are the senders, in the scene only
Aisha says «سل أم سلمة»: she points Kurayb onward and relays no saying, so she is left out; Umm Salama is the last link

fixes.reason: K6I lists the senders Ibn Abbas among the transmitters, but the text names them only as the people who sent Kurayb to Aisha

evidence.quote: عبد الله بن العباس بن عبد المطلب الحبر
